Laravel app; expert in: inertiajs/inertia-laravel v2, laravel/fortify v1, laravel/framework v12, laravel/prompts v0, laravel/wayfinder v0, laravel/boost v2, laravel/mcp v0, laravel/pail v1, laravel/pint v1, laravel/sail v1, pestphp/pest v4, phpunit/phpunit v12. Follow these version-specific conventions.

**Skills:** `wayfinder-development` — MUST activate whenever referencing backend routes in frontend components, importing from `@/actions` or `@/routes`, calling Laravel routes from TypeScript, or working with Wayfinder route functions. `pest-testing` — MUST activate when writing tests, creating unit or feature tests, adding assertions, testing Livewire components, browser testing, debugging test failures, working with datasets or mocking; or when user mentions test, spec, TDD, expects, assertion, coverage, or needs to verify functionality works.

Follow existing code conventions; check sibling files for structure, approach, and naming. Use descriptive variable/method names. Check for reusable components first. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover that functionality and prove they work. Unit and feature tests are more important. Stick to existing directory structure; don't create new base folders without approval. Do not change dependencies without approval. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user. Be concise.

If frontend changes aren't reflected, ask user to run `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, or `composer run dev`.

Use Laravel Boost MCP tools. Use `list-artisan-commands` to check Artisan parameters; `get-absolute-url` whenever sharing a project URL; `tinker` for PHP debugging or direct Eloquent queries; `database-query` for read-only database access; `database-schema` before writing migrations or models; `browser-logs` for recent browser errors/logs (ignore old logs).

Before code changes, use `search-docs` for version-specific Laravel/ecosystem documentation. Pass package filters when known; don't include package names in queries. Use multiple broad, simple topic queries. Query syntax: stemming (`authentication`), AND (`rate limit`), exact phrase (`"infinite scroll"`), mixed (`middleware "rate limit"`), or alternatives (`queries=["authentication", "middleware"]`).

Use curly braces for all control structures, including single-line bodies. Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion; do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters unless private. Declare explicit return types and parameter types. Example: `protected function isAccessible(User $user, ?string $path = null): bool`. Enum keys typically TitleCase. Prefer PHPDoc over inline comments; never comment in code unless logic is exceptionally complex. Add useful array shape types where appropriate.

Herd serves the app at `https?://[kebab-case-project-dir].test`; use `get-absolute-url` for valid URLs. You must not run any commands to make the site available via HTTP(S). It is always available through Laravel Herd.

Every change must be programmatically tested. Write a new test or update an existing test, then run the affected tests to make sure they pass. Run the minimum number of tests needed to ensure code quality and speed. Use `php artisan test --compact` with a specific filename or filter.

**Inertia v2:** Components are in `resources/js/pages` (unless `vite.config.js` says otherwise); use `Inertia::render()` for server routing, not Blade. ALWAYS use `search-docs` for version-specific Inertia docs/examples. Check docs before changes; v1/v2 features include deferred props, infinite scrolling (merging props + `WhenVisible`), lazy loading on scroll, polling, and prefetching. Deferred props need an empty state with pulsing or animated skeleton.

**Laravel:** Use `php artisan make:` for files (migrations, controllers, models, etc.); use `php artisan make:class` for generic PHP classes. Pass `--no-interaction` to all Artisan commands and correct `--options`; use `list-artisan-commands` to check options. Use typed Eloquent relationship methods; prefer relationships and Eloquent over raw queries/manual joins or `DB::` (prefer `Model::query()`); use query builder for very complex operations. Prevent N+1 with eager loading. New models need useful factories and seeders; ask whether more are needed and use `list-artisan-commands` to check `php artisan make:model` options. APIs default to versioned Eloquent API Resources unless existing routes use another convention. Always use Form Request classes (rules and custom messages), checking sibling requests for array/string rule style. Use built-in auth/authorization; named routes and `route()` for links; `ShouldQueue` jobs for time-consuming work. Use environment variables only in config files; never call `env()` elsewhere—use `config('app.name')`, not `env('APP_NAME')`. Test models use factories; check custom states. Follow existing Faker convention (`$this->faker` or `fake()`). Create tests with `php artisan make:test [options] {name}`; pass `--unit` for unit tests; most tests should be feature tests. For `Illuminate\Foundation\ViteException: Unable to locate file in Vite manifest`, run `npm run build` or ask user to run `npm run dev` or `composer run dev`. CRITICAL: ALWAYS use `search-docs` for version-specific Laravel docs/examples. Laravel 12 uses streamlined Laravel 11 structure: middleware are configured in `bootstrap/app.php` via `Application::configure()->withMiddleware()`, not `app/Http/Kernel.php`; `bootstrap/app.php` registers middleware, exceptions, and routing; providers are in `bootstrap/providers.php`; `app\Console\Kernel.php` no longer exists—use `bootstrap/app.php` or `routes/console.php`; `app/Console/Commands/` commands auto-register. Column-altering migrations must retain all existing attributes. Laravel 12 supports limiting eager loads natively (`$query->latest()->limit(10);`). Prefer model `casts()` over `$casts` where consistent with sibling models.

**Wayfinder:** Import route functions from `@/actions/` (controllers) or `@/routes/` (named routes). Invokable: `import StorePost from '@/actions/.../StorePostController'; StorePost()`. Route keys: `{post:slug}` → `show({ slug: "my-post" })`. Query merge: `show(1, { mergeQuery: { page: 2, sort: null } })`; null removes params. Inertia: use `.form()` with `<Form>` or `form.submit(store())` with useForm.

**Pint:** Before finalizing changes, run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent`. Do not run `vendor/bin/pint --test --format agent`, simply run `vendor/bin/pint --format agent` to fix formatting issues.

**Pest:** Create tests with `php artisan make:test --pest {name}`. Run `php artisan test --compact` or `php artisan test --compact --filter=testName`. Do NOT delete tests without approval. CRITICAL: ALWAYS use `search-docs` for version-specific Pest docs/examples. IMPORTANT: Activate `pest-testing` every time you're working with a Pest or testing-related task.
